b110KeyboardFocusDefect.requiredFix: START-HERE 'Known exceptions' 1 + B8-03 + B8-08: below 760px show the sort as a visible control above the rows (or take the hidden header’s controls out of the tab order and provide a visible equivalent). Recommended for the shared DataTable component: in labelled-row mode render a visible 'Sort by' control (same accessible state as aria-sort) above the rows and make the hidden thead non-focusable (e.g. display:none/inert on interactive header content at that container width).
